stock.description: TATA Health International Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company with diverse business interests, including the sale of footwear and healthcare goods, in addition to offering financial and online medical services. Its operations are structured into distinct segments: Footwear Products Trading, Healthcare Products Trading, Financial Services, and Online Medical Services. The company engages in both wholesale and retail distribution of footwear, featuring prominent brands like Clarks and Josef Seibel. By December 31, 2021, its retail footprint included 29 stores in Hong Kong and one in Macau. Furthermore, its financial services division provides expertise in securities advisory, investment management, and corporate finance consultancy. The company maintains a geographical presence across Hong Kong, Australia, Macau, and Mainland China. Founded in 1974 and headquartered in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong, the firm rebranded from S. Culture International Holdings Limited to its current name in November 2020.
